annotations.title: Redo an image for free (wrong product or text)

description: Makes a free new version of an image whose product came out different (shape, label, colour, logo) or whose text is wrong. Limits: 3 per image and a monthly allowance per account; outside them use regenerate_image or edit_image (1 credit). Free. Returns the new image id. Ask the person what is wrong and pass it as note. Example: {"image_id": "…", "reason": "product-changed", "note": "the label says 250 ml, it should be 500 ml"}

note.description: What exactly is wrong, in the person’s words, e.g. "the cap is silver, it should be gold"

name: redo_image
